Run a local BLAST search against a custom database

blast.Rd

Run a local BLAST search against a custom database

Usage

blast(query, db_path, evalue = 1e-05, max_target_seqs = 10)

Arguments

query

Character. Path to a query FASTA file, or a raw DNA sequence string.

db_path

Character. Path to the BLAST database (the base name returned by bcdm2blastdb()).

evalue

Numeric. Expectation value (E) threshold for saving hits. Default is 1e-5.

max_target_seqs

Integer. Maximum number of aligned sequences to keep per query. Default is 10.

Value

A data.frame of BLAST tabular hits (format 6), or NULL if no hits are found.

See also

Other blast: bcdm2blastdb()
